UEXT0002.author: ClinLine

Citations.Cited_Guidance: An extension attribute should have exactly one value attribute specified or include nested extension attributes not both.

UEXT0002.description: An extension attribute should have exactly one value attribute specified or include nested extension attributes not both.

Citations.Cited_Guidance: An extension attribute should have exactly one value attribute specified or include nested extension attributes not both.

UEXT0002.conditions:
**@$pt.$distinct(
    [$pt.extensionAttributes@$ea.
    $ea.{"id": id,
         "instanceType": instanceType,
         "path": _path,
         "extensionUrl": url,
         "extensionAttributes": extensionAttributes ? "Defined",
         "valueExtensionClass": valueExtensionClass ? "Defined",
         "valueId": valueId,
         "valueBoolean": valueBoolean,
         "valueCode": valueCode.id ? valueCode.decode,
         "valueString": valueString,
         "valueRange": valueRange.id ? (($exists(valueRange.minValue.value) ? valueRange.minValue.value & " - ") & valueRange.maxValue.value),
         "valueQuantity": valueQuantity.value,
         "valueInteger": valueInteger,
         "specifiedItems": (extensionAttributes ? "extensionAttributes defined / ") & (valueExtensionClass ? "valueExtensionClass defined / ")
                             & (valueId ? "valueId=" & valueId & " / ")  & (valueBoolean ? "valueBoolean=" & valueBoolean & " / ")
                             &  (valueCode ? "valueCode.decode=" & valueCode.decode & " / ") & (valueString ? "valueString=" & valueString & " / ")
                             & (valueRange ? "valueRange=" & (($exists(valueRange.minValue.value) ? valueRange.minValue.value & " - ") & valueRange.maxValue.value) & " / ")  
                             & (valueQuantity ? "valueQuantity=" & valueQuantity.value & " / ") &  (valueInteger ? "valueInteger=" & valueInteger & " / ")  ,
         "noOfSpecifiedItems": (extensionAttributes ? 1:0)+(valueExtensionClass ? 1:0)+(valueId?1:0)+(valueBoolean != null ? 1:0)+(valueCode?1:0)+(valueString?1:0)+(valueRange?1:0)+(valueQuantity?1:0)+(valueInteger?1:0)}]
         [noOfSpecifiedItems != 1])

params.message: Either more than 1 extension attribute type or class is specified and/or none are specified for an extension.

UEXT0003.author: ClinLine

Citations.Cited_Guidance: The structure within a specified extension identified by a distinct url must be logically consistent throughout the data model e.g. a url in combination with the value type or nested extensions should be unique.

UEXT0003.description: The structure within a specified extension identified by a distinct url must be logically consistent throughout the data model e.g. a url in combination with the value type or nested extensions should be unique.

Citations.Cited_Guidance: The structure within a specified extension identified by a distinct url must be logically consistent throughout the data model e.g. a url in combination with the value type or nested extensions should be unique.

UEXT0003.conditions:
**@$sd
    .
    $filter($sd.extensionAttributes.
        {"id": id, 
        "extensionUrl": url, 
        "instanceType": instanceType,
        "_path": _path,
        "defined": extensionAttributes ? "extensionAttributes"  : valueExtensionClass ? "valueExtensionClass" :
                    valueId ? "valueId" : valueBoolean ? "valueBoolean" : 
                    valueCode ? "valueCode" : valueString ? "valueString" : 
                    valueRange ? "valueRange": valueQuantity ? "valueQuantity" : 
                    valueInteger ? "valueInteger"}
    ,function($v,$i,$a)
      {
        $count($a[extensionUrl=$v.extensionUrl and defined!=$v.defined])>0
      })

params.message: The combination of the url with a specified value type is not unique.
